events.name: Civora
events.tagline: Enterprise-Grade Civic Issue Reporting & Public Accountability Platform
events.summary: Establishes a direct, transparent, and auditable bridge between Citizens, Government Officials, Civic Contractors, and Administrators by digitizing the entire municipal resolution pipeline.
events.description: Civora connects the full municipal issue lifecycle—photographic field reporting, departmental triage, SLA tracking, municipal tendering, contractor milestone verification, and defect liability management—ensuring verifiable public service delivery.
events.brief_description: Establishes a direct, transparent, and auditable bridge between Citizens, Government Officials, Civic Contractors, and Administrators by digitizing the entire municipal resolution pipeline. Civora connects the full municipal issue lifecycle—photographic field reporting, departmental triage, SLA tracking, municipal tendering, contractor milestone verification, and defect liability management—ensuring verifiable public service delivery.

techStack.frontend: React 19.2, Vite 8.3, TypeScript 6.0, Tailwind CSS 4.3, Leaflet 1.9 (GIS)
techStack.ai_vision: Google Gemini API (@google/genai 2.32) for multimodal triage/fraud analysis; Custom dHash (Hamming distance) & SHA-256 for perceptual deduplication
techStack.security: JWT & BcryptJS dual auth, Zod 4.6 runtime validation, Multer 2.4

features: Photographic issue capture with interactive Leaflet municipal GIS mapping
Multimodal Gemini AI complaint triage, relevance validation, and automated fraud scoring
Perceptual dHash image deduplication to eliminate duplicate citizen reports
End-to-end municipal pipeline: SLA tracking, tendering, contractor milestones, and defect liability

events.name: PRAMAAN
events.tagline: Evidence-Backed Skill Profiles & Hackathon Team Matchmaking
events.summary: Transforms self-reported technical claims into verified, evidence-backed developer profiles while helping hackathon teams assemble complementary skill sets.
events.description: PRAMAAN eliminates unverified claims in developer portfolios and hackathon team formations. Authentication is intentionally replaced by secure, scoped HTTP-only browser cookie profile switching, avoiding heavyweight login hurdles for rapid participant matchmaking.
events.brief_description: Transforms self-reported technical claims into verified, evidence-backed developer profiles while helping hackathon teams assemble complementary skill sets. PRAMAAN eliminates unverified claims in developer portfolios and hackathon team formations. Authentication is intentionally replaced by secure, scoped HTTP-only browser cookie profile switching, avoiding heavyweight login hurdles for rapid participant matchmaking.

techStack.frontend: React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4, Leaflet GIS
techStack.ai_vision: Google Gemini API integration & automated profile validation logic
techStack.security: Secure HTTP-only session cookie management and Zod schema sanitization

features: Evidence-backed skill verification converting raw claims into proof artifacts
Smart algorithmic matchmaking for hackathon squads needing complementary tech stacks
Zero-friction profile handling via lightweight secure HTTP-only browser cookies
Interactive profile discovery and direct team builder explorer

events.name: DailyTrack
events.tagline: Modern Habit & Collaborative Task Management Platform
events.summary: Streamlines daily engineering routines, sustains accountability streaks, and enables real-time social task collaboration.
events.description: A high-performance productivity workspace engineered to balance granular task execution with social accountability. Supports daily habit streaks, collaborative workspaces, and real-time activity monitoring for teams and accountability partners.

events.name: SkillGap
events.tagline: Smart Technical Competency Matching & Gap Analysis Platform
events.summary: Analyzes target engineering roles, identifies missing technical competencies, and generates actionable roadmaps to bridge skill voids.
events.description: A dedicated career-readiness tool designed to map a developer's current skill repertoire against real-world job specifications and industry benchmarks, pinpointing exact knowledge gaps with tailored learning directives.
